# Sample Document

A neutral markdown source used by the ingest trajectory evals. It contains two
topics that already have corpus pages, so a clean ingest run should match the
existing pages instead of creating duplicates.

## MLX

MLX is a machine learning framework developed by Apple for efficient training
and inference on Apple Silicon devices. It uses the Apple Metal API for GPU
acceleration and takes advantage of unified memory for faster data access.

## Tool Calling

Tool calling is a capability of large language models to invoke external
functions or APIs, allowing the model to fetch real-time data, perform actions,
and interact with software systems.
